# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **Date and Time Display**: "Oct 23 02:03" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three standard window control buttons are located on the far right of the title bar:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize/Restore button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is displayed on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help
- **File Menu**: The "File" menu is currently open, displaying a dropdown list of options.

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu Options**:
  - New Text File (Ctrl+N)
  - New File... (Alt+Ctrl+N)
  - New Window (Ctrl+Shift+N)
  - Open File... (Ctrl+O)
  - Open Folder... [Ctrl+K Ctrl+O]
  - Open Workspace from File...
  - Open Recent (with right arrow indicating submenu)
  - Add Folder to Workspace...
  - Save Workspace As...
  - Duplicate Workspace
  - Save (Ctrl+S)
  - Save As... (Ctrl+Shift+S)
  - Save All
  - Share (with right arrow indicating submenu)
  - Auto Save
  - Preferences (with right arrow indicating submenu)
  - Revert File
  - Close Editor
  - Close Folder [Ctrl+K F]
  - Close Window (Alt+F4)
  - Exit (Ctrl+Q)

## Left Sidebar (Activity Tray)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side of the screen contains various application icons:
  - Google Chrome
  - Microsoft Edge
  - Visual Studio Code (active)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash
- **System Tray Icons**: At the bottom of the sidebar, there are system tray icons:
  - User profile icon
  - Settings icon with a notification badge (number 1)
  - Status indicators for source control (0 commits, 0 changes, 0 conflicts)

## Main Application Interface

- **Welcome Page Title**: "Visual Studio Code" is prominently displayed at the top center.
- **Subtitle**: "Editing evolved" is shown directly below the main title.
- **Start Section**:
  - Contains four quick-start options:
    - New File... (with document icon)
    - Open File... (with folder icon)
    - Open Folder... (with folder icon)
    - Connect to... (with cloud icon)
- **Recent Section**:
  - Displays the message: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - Contains two walkthrough options:
    - Get Started with VS Code (highlighted with a blue star icon, description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding")
    - Learn the Fundamentals (with a blue lightbulb icon)
- **Startup Setting**:
  - A checkbox labeled "Show welcome page on startup" is located at the bottom right of the interface, currently checked.

## Status Bar

- **Bottom Status Bar**: Located at the very bottom of the interface.
- **Status Bar Elements**:
  - Source control indicators (0 commits, 0 changes, 0 conflicts)
  - A small icon on the far right, likely for extensions or notifications.

## Visual Design

- **Color Scheme**: Dark theme with light text and icons.
- **Typography**: Clean, modern sans-serif font.
- **Icons**: Consistent use of simple, recognizable icons for each function.
- **Layout**: Hierarchical and intuitive, with clear separation between sections.
